name: pr-review-ui
description: PR reviews as numbered points in the conversation, in one standard format. The PR is checked out into a review worktree, and each point's code opens beside it with the PR's changes highlighted like git diff: in your editor from a VS Code, JetBrains, Zed or Neovim terminal, in terminal-browser in Ghostty or kitty, or in a code pane.

codeView.title: Where review code shows
codeView.description: auto follows your terminal: the editor in a VS Code, JetBrains, Zed or Neovim terminal, terminal-browser (the GitHub page, lines highlighted) in Ghostty or kitty when it is installed, and the code pane everywhere else, including the desktop app. ide, browser and pane pick one always.

ideCommand.title: Editor command
ideCommand.description: The command that opens a file at a line, such as code, cursor, zed, idea or goland. Leave empty to find the editor you run Claude Code in.

ghPath.title: gh executable
ghPath.description: The GitHub CLI the review uses to read the PR diff. Use a full path if gh is not on the PATH Claude Code sees.

autoReview.title: Review when you ask for one
autoReview.description: Treat a prompt that says review with a GitHub PR link, a PR link alone, or "review pr", "review pr 418", "pr review" as a review request: the PR is checked out into a review worktree and the review comes back in the points format, without the slash command.

offerSetup.title: Offer to install what it needs
offerSetup.description: Once after install, and before a review when the GitHub CLI is missing, ask whether to install what pr-review-ui uses and this machine lacks: the GitHub CLI, Ghostty and terminal-browser. Nothing is installed without a yes.
